other_failure_modes.name: Execution Timeout
other_failure_modes.description: The script attempts to train a large ensemble of computationally expensive models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost, ExtraTrees, PyTorch) inside a 5-fold loop on what is likely a large dataset, leading to the process timing out before completion.

summary: The agent successfully implements a complex stacking ensemble and deep learning model with solid feature engineering. However, it fails to account for the temporal and subject-grouped nature of the event data, using a random StratifiedKFold that introduces look-ahead bias and data leakage. Additionally, the sheer complexity of training 25 base models and a meta-model causes the script to time out after 2 hours.
